comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Thanks for sharing the days honestly, including the losing ones. The goal of 5 to 10% a day is the part I'd change, because a bot told to hit a daily target tends to take bigger risks to get there, and no honest strategy delivers that every day. In your screenshots the first day's gain is much larger than every day after it, so it's worth checking whether the whole result rests on that one day. I'd give the bot a fixed risk per trade and a daily loss limit instead, then judge it over several weeks against just holding the index. Cymetica lets you connect your own AI agent and run it in paper mode first, which is a similar way to build that record.
